name: Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA)
role: Umbrella civic authority for the city. Day-to-day services are delivered by the five city corporations (Central, East, North, South, West) that sit under it.
helplineNote: Sahaya helpline / app (long-standing BBMP number - confirm it still routes to GBA)
tip: Log a complaint on the Sahaya app with a geotagged photo - you get a ticket number you can escalate.

name: Five City Corporations
role: Bengaluru Central, East, North, South and West City Corporations. Your ward office, health officer, engineers and Marshals sit here.
helplineNote: Same Sahaya helpline routes to your ward
tip: Find your ward first - it decides which corporation and which Assistant Executive Engineer owns your street.

name: Bangalore Electricity Supply Company (BESCOM)
role: Electricity distribution for Bengaluru and surrounding districts.
handles: New connections, load change, name transfer
notHandles: Street-light bulbs/poles maintenance (corporation) - BESCOM only supplies power
tip: For a live wire or transformer spark treat it as an emergency: stay away, call 1912 and quote the nearest landmark and pole number.

name: Bangalore Water Supply & Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
role: Cauvery water supply, borewell-support, sewerage and sewage treatment.
notHandles: Open storm-water drains and roadside nallahs (corporation)
tip: Manhole overflowing? Photograph it with a landmark and quote the sub-division in your complaint.

name: Regional Transport Offices (Transport Department)
role: Driving licences, vehicle registration and permits. Bengaluru has several RTOs (KA-01 Koramangala, KA-02 Rajajinagar, KA-03 Indiranagar, KA-04 Yeshwanthpur, KA-05 Jayanagar and more) - your address decides yours.
tip: Most licence and RC services are on Parivahan - book the slot online and carry originals only for the biometric/test step.

name: Bengaluru Traffic Police (BTP)
role: Traffic enforcement, e-challans, signal/junction issues and accident response.
notHandles: Pothole repair (corporation) - though BTP can flag it
helplineNote: Emergency 112; traffic helpline numbers are on the BTP site
tip: Check pending challans by vehicle number on the BTP/Karnataka One portals before buying a used vehicle.

name: Karnataka State Police - Emergency 112
role: Emergencies, crime, noise after permitted hours, women & child safety.
helplineNote: Unified emergency number. Fire 101, ambulance 108, women 181, child 1098, cyber-fraud 1930
tip: For cyber-fraud call 1930 immediately - speed matters for freezing funds.

name: BMTC & Namma Metro (BMRCL)
handles: Metro operations, smart cards, lost property
helplineNote: Use the official apps/sites for current contacts
tip: Keep the bus number, time and stop name - complaints without them rarely get traced.

name: Karnataka State Pollution Control Board
role: Industrial pollution, air/water quality, noise norms and lake-pollution enforcement.
tip: Include dated photos/videos - pollution complaints need evidence of recurrence.

name: Dept. of Stamps & Registration (Kaveri)
role: Property registration, encumbrance certificates and stamp duty.
tip: Get an EC and check khata (A-khata vs B-khata) before you pay a token advance.

name: National Consumer Helpline
tip: Send a written notice first; most complaints get resolved at that stage.
